May your new year be filled with joy and success, and may luck follow you in every part of your life. Us from Zodiacus Games would like to wish every player a very blessed New Year! Happy 2022! 

We are grateful to all of you for the active support in our games. Next year we plan to continue actively working on new projects.

Our plans for 2022:
Her New Memory release date from Early Access: January 12, 2022.
Everburning release date: 1Q, 2022 (second team).
New project release date: 3Q, 2022 (core team).

notes.title: Christmas Update (v.0.7.2)
notes.content:
Added CG, 3 Christmas themed costumes and accessory to the game.

Note: Items for Christmas are going to be available only for 14 days in the game store. If you get them during this period of time, they will be in your save file permanently, however if you miss out on the opportunity you will not be able to unlock it after the 14 days.

The ability to purchase Christmas items is valid for the account. If you have already completed the Christmas event within the game, for different game saves, you can buy items even after the official end of the event.

P.S. We have made a decision to abandon the time limit for the event; themed items will remain in the in-game store forever.
